title: This Solid Is 99.8 Percent Air and Stops a Blowtorch

scenes.text: There's a solid that is ninety nine point eight percent air.
It's called aerogel, and Guinness lists it as the lightest solid in the world.
A block weighing about one pound can support roughly half a ton.
It blocks heat so well that a blowtorch on one side is barely felt on the other.
NASA used it to catch comet dust hitting at six times the speed of a rifle bullet.
Almost nothing, holding up almost everything.

description:
